Results.ReviewText: Burns really nice. Much easier to clean than the old grill I had from Walmart. Functionality seems a lot more thought out too. Igniter battery being placed behind the door in an easy to access spot vs wedging your arm up behind the dials. Seems like a no-brainer. Propane arm that gauges how much is left is an awesome bonus I didn’t know I needed. 2 sided grates for different meats/marks. We grabbed a flat top grate too, but haven’t tried it out yet. Loving this purchase.
Results.Title: Everything you didn’t know you needed in a grill.

Results.ReviewText: I love our Weber Spirit E-310! Although it’s supposedly a step-down from my old Genesis model, the Spirit is solid; heats evenly and it has plenty of space.

Results.ReviewText: Weber grills are a top of the line product, however, this current model is not up to the standard we expected. Let me explain....the tank holder is a huge mistake, there is no need for this design at all, and the tank hole in the bottom of the inside grill base is too large that the tank sits on the floor of whatever you have your grill sitting on, ie, patio surface, etc. Whomever designed this made a huge mistake in our opinion. Reconsider the design for future models, other than that the grill works fine as expected.
Results.Title: Poor design this time around!

46510001.Name: Spirit E-310 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
46510001.Description:
Add flavor to the menu with a Spirit E-310. It’s the ideal grill for entertaining a small crowd or a perfect solution to any family meal. Place serving trays and spices on the side tables so that everything you need is where you are, when you need it. With features such as porcelain-enameled, cast-iron cooking grates that retain even heat, you’re guaranteed the best tasting food. It’s built to last with a cookbox that helps prevent rusting and peeling, and conveniently equipped with six tool hooks for easy accessibility of grilling tools. If that wasn’t enough, the low maintenance and easy-to-clean grease management system takes the hassle out of cooking.


• Durable, easy-to-clean porcelain-enamel cast iron grates.

• Porcelain-enameled finish helps prevent rusting and pealing.

• Six tool hooks for easy accessibility of grilling tools.

• Low maintenance and easy-to-clean grease management system.

• 424 square inches of main grilling space.


 This product requires assembly.
